Illustrative hunting settlements

Source: R/data.R
manu_settlements.Rd

Synthetic settlement locations and hunter populations for the spatial source-sink model ot_biode(). Place names are Amazonian but the coordinates and populations are simulated and illustrative only.

Usage

manu_settlements

Format

A data frame with 4 rows and 4 variables:

settlement

Settlement name.

x_km

X coordinate (km).

y_km

Y coordinate (km).

hunters

Number of hunters.

Source

Simulated.

See also

ot_biode()
